summary: Iter 181 — POS back-dated bills feature (Miracurl salon SaaS). Full backend + frontend verification. 8/8 backend pytest scenarios PASSED. All 3 frontend requirements PASSED: (1) POS InvoiceHeader pos-bill-date input defaults today with min=today-2 & max=today, (2) pos-backdated-badge appears amber when picking yesterday and hides when picking today, (3) Reports/BillLookup InvoiceTable renders bill-backdated-<id> BACK-DATED chip on the created row.
critical_code_review_comments: _apply_bill_date sets inv['backdated']=True only when a past date is picked — Invoice model doesn't declare `backdated`/`actual_created_at` fields; they are added dynamically. Works because the doc is inserted as-is, but consider adding these as optional fields on the Invoice pydantic model for API contract clarity.

Response for status='completed' path does not surface an explicit 'status' field (Invoice model has no status attribute); UI uses invoice.status only for OPEN/VOID chips so it's fine, but a future consumer might expect status='completed' in the JSON.

InvoiceHeader input uses min/max HTML5 constraints — browsers on the mobile date picker enforce them, but a user typing '2026-09-18' manually can still set it to a value outside min; the backend catches this with the 400. Good defence-in-depth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_pos_backdated_bills.py — re-run with `pytest test_pos_backdated_bills.py -o addopts=''` (project has xdist enabled in pytest.ini, override to avoid parallel-worker ordering). Verified: bill_date=yesterday → backdated true & created_at=YYYY-MM-DDT06:30:00+00:00 (12:00 IST); bill_date -3d → 400 'Bills can be back-dated up to 2 days only'; future → 400 'Bill date can\'t be in the future'; today → normal (no backdated flag); omitted → normal; completed backdated bill is returned by GET /api/invoices?date=<yesterday>; DELETE /api/invoices/{id} → 200 for open, 400 for completed. UI: pos-bill-date-wrap + pos-bill-date + pos-backdated-badge on POS page; bill-backdated-<id> on Reports InvoiceTable rows. What's New modal now advertises the feature — dismiss with 'Got it ✦' button.
rca of the issue: No issues. Feature implementation matches spec exactly. Only cosmetic observation: Invoice pydantic model doesn't declare backdated/actual_created_at fields explicitly — added dynamically to the dict before insert, so responses and stored docs both carry them.
